heading_fil: Bago simulan ni Ana ang araw
display_fil: Si Ana, 33, ay may duty sa station at home visits. Basang sahig, halos punong sharps box at mainit na biyahe: tukuyin kung sino ang maaaring masaktan at anong kontrol ang kailangan.
display_en: Ana, 33, has station work and home visits. Wet floor, nearly full sharps box and a hot route: identify who could be harmed and what control is needed.

display_fil: Station check: basang sahig, harang sa exit, walang sabon. Itala ang panganib → posibleng pinsala → kontrol → reporting contact. Ilayo muna ang tao sa panganib; tiyaking naayos bago alisin ang babala.
display_en: Station check: wet floor, blocked exit, no soap. Record hazard → potential harm → control → reporting contact. Keep people away from danger; confirm correction before removing a warning.

display_fil: Limang grupo: sharps, impeksyon, pananakit ng katawan, stress, aksidente. Sa isa: pangalanan ang pinsala, kontrol at contact.
display_en: Five groups: sharps, infections, body discomfort, stress, accidents. For one, name the harm, control and contact.

display_fil: Ang pagkilala sa panganib ay dapat humantong sa tiyak na kontrol at taong tutugon.
display_en: Recognizing a hazard should lead to a specific control and responsible contact.

check.prompt_fil: May basang sahig sa pasukan. Aling ulat ang magagamit agad?
check.prompt_en: The entrance floor is wet. Which report supports immediate action?

options.fil: “Basang pasukan, panganib madulas; ilayo muna ang tao at ipatama sa responsableng staff.”
options.en: “Wet entrance, slip risk; keep people away and arrange correction with responsible staff.”

options.fil: “Mag-ingat na lang ang lahat hanggang uwian.”

options.en: “Nobody was hurt, so no action is needed.”

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang ulat ay may lugar, panganib at aksyon. Ang paalala lamang ay hindi nag-aalis ng panganib; ang kawalan ng pinsala ngayon ay hindi dahilan para maghintay.
check.feedback_en: The first report gives location, risk and action. A reminder alone does not remove the hazard; absence of injury now is no reason to wait.
